publicBeta.queueRule: first eligible applications by received timestamp after status becomes open
eligibility: Currently participating in or preparing to continue the official Indonesia G-to-G Korea / EPS E-9 process
Willing to use Korea Employment Passport during the real process
Willing to provide good-faith feedback about unclear, missing, rejected, or broker-dependent steps
feedback: Report any point where an official answer is missing or unclear
Report any step that still requires a calo/private intermediary
Provide short follow-up feedback when the real EPS stage changes, when reasonably possible

retrospectivePanel.role: Indonesian E-9 workers already in Korea who validate instructions against real experience
eligibility: Currently working in Korea with E-9 status
Previously went through Indonesia G-to-G Korea / EPS process
Willing to compare app guidance with real experience and report mismatches

privacy.note: Application email is handled outside the public repository. Never send identity-document images for beta enrollment.
